PostSummary: The trend says to protect your peace by blocking out anything negative — hard emotions, hard conversations, hard truths — and curating only positivity. Sadness, anger, and grief get treated as spiritual failures.
BiblicalResponse: Peace is a gift, but it was never meant to mean pretending everything is fine. Jesus wept, lamented, and faced suffering head-on, and Scripture gives us an entire book of laments. Real hope does not deny pain; it carries pain to a God who is near to the brokenhearted and promises that sorrow is not the end of the story.
